title: Study of hydroxocobalamin at a new concentration for cobalamin-related remethylation disorders.
official: Study of hydroxocobalamin at a new concentration for cobalamin-related remethylation disorders.
summary: Main objective: to determine whether the administration of high doses of hydroxycobalamin decreases the blood concentration of tHcy and to compare the decrease with treatment at standard doses.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Pediatric patients under 2 years of age.
2. Patients with genetic diagnosis of any of the Cbl-RD diseases with early diagnosis who present ocular manifestations
3. Patients whose legal representative or, failing that, caregivers of the patient give written informed consent
4. Patients who, at the investigator's discretion, can complete the total follow-up of the study
Exclusion criteria:
1. Premature patients born before 32 weeks of gestation
2. Patients with any other relevant pathology not associated with Cbl-RD diseases who, according to the physician's criteria, are not candidates to participate in the study.
3. Patients who present any contraindication to receive treatment with hydroxycobalamin, including hypersensitivity to the active ingredient (hydroxycobalamin) or to any of its excipients, according to the specifications of its data sheet
4. Participation in another clinical trial that prevents the patient's inclusion in the study
